mapper.select: SELECT POSITION_ID AS positionId, STOCK_GROUP AS stockGroup, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, MARKET_CODE AS marketCode, TOTAL_QTY AS totalQty, AVG_PRICE AS avgPrice, CLOSE_FLAG AS closeFlag, STATE_CODE AS stateCode, LAST_TXN_ID AS lastTxnId, SOURCE_PICK_ID AS sourcePickId, BUY_DATE AS buyDate, TARGET_PRICE AS targetPrice, STOP_PRICE AS stopPrice, TP1_PRICE AS tp1Price, SELL_GUIDE_STATE AS sellGuideState, LAST_SELL_SIGNAL_CODE AS lastSellSignalCode, LAST_TRACK_DATE AS lastTrackDate, MODIFY_DATE AS modifyDate, CREATE_USER AS createUser, CREATE_DATE AS createDate FROM TB_S_POSITION WHERE 1=1 AND STOCK_GROUP = #{stockGroup} AND CLOSE_FLAG = #{closeFlag} AND MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode} ORDER BY MODIFY_DATE DESC

SELECT POSITION_ID AS positionId, STOCK_GROUP AS stockGroup, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, MARKET_CODE AS marketCode, TOTAL_QTY AS totalQty, AVG_PRICE AS avgPrice, CLOSE_FLAG AS closeFlag, STATE_CODE AS stateCode, LAST_TXN_ID AS lastTxnId, SOURCE_PICK_ID AS sourcePickId, BUY_DATE AS buyDate, TARGET_PRICE AS targetPrice, STOP_PRICE AS stopPrice, TP1_PRICE AS tp1Price, SELL_GUIDE_STATE AS sellGuideState, LAST_SELL_SIGNAL_CODE AS lastSellSignalCode, LAST_TRACK_DATE AS lastTrackDate, MODIFY_DATE AS modifyDate, CREATE_USER AS createUser, CREATE_DATE AS createDate FROM TB_S_POSITION WHERE 1=1 AND POSITION_ID = #{positionId} AND STOCK_GROUP = #{stockGroup} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} ORDER BY POSITION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_S_POSITION ( STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, MARKET_CODE, TOTAL_QTY, AVG_PRICE, CLOSE_FLAG, STATE_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DATE, MODIFY_DATE ) VALUES ( #{stockGroup}, #{stockCode}, #{marketCode}, #{totalQty}, #{avgPrice}, NVL(#{closeFlag}, 'N'), NVL(#{stateCode}, 'HOLD'), #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_S_POSITION SET TOTAL_QTY = #{totalQty}, AVG_PRICE = #{avgPrice}, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE, STATE_CODE = NVL(#{stateCode}, STATE_CODE) WHERE POSITION_ID = #{positionId}

UPDATE TB_S_POSITION SET SOURCE_PICK_ID = NVL(#{sourcePickId}, SOURCE_PICK_ID), BUY_DATE = NVL(#{buyDate}, BUY_DATE), TARGET_PRICE = NVL(#{targetPrice}, TARGET_PRICE), STOP_PRICE = NVL(#{stopPrice}, STOP_PRICE), TP1_PRICE = NVL(#{tp1Price}, TP1_PRICE), SELL_GUIDE_STATE = NVL(#{sellGuideState}, SELL_GUIDE_STATE), LAST_SELL_SIGNAL_CODE = NVL(#{lastSellSignalCode}, LAST_SELL_SIGNAL_CODE), LAST_TRACK_DATE = NVL(#{lastTrackDate}, LAST_TRACK_DATE), MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE POSITION_ID = #{positionId}
UPDATE TB_S_POSITION SET CLOSE_FLAG = 'Y', STATE_CODE = 'CLOSED', MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE POSITION_ID = #{positionId}

UPDATE TB_S_POSITION SET TOTAL_QTY = TOTAL_QTY + TO_NUMBER(#{addQty}), AVG_PRICE = ((TOTAL_QTY * AVG_PRICE) + (TO_NUMBER(#{addQty}) * TO_NUMBER(#{addPrice}))) / (TOTAL_QTY + TO_NUMBER(#{addQty})), MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE POSITION_ID = #{positionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_S_POSITION_TXN ( POSITION_ID, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, ACTION_TYPE, QTY, PRICE, BEFORE_QTY, BEFORE_AVG, AFTER_QTY, AFTER_AVG, REASON_TEXT, JSON_PARAMS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{positionId}, #{stockGroup}, #{stockCode}, #{actionType}, NVL(#{qty},0), NVL(#{price},0), #{beforeQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{beforeAvg,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{afterQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{afterAvg,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reasonText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jsonParams,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TXN_ID, POSITION_ID, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, ACTION_TYPE, QTY, PRICE, BEFORE_QTY, BEFORE_AVG, AFTER_QTY, AFTER_AVG, REASON_TEXT, JSON_PARAMS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DATE FROM TB_S_POSITION_TXN WHERE 1=1 AND POSITION_ID = #{positionId} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_S_POSITION_EVENT ( POSITION_ID, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_LEVEL, EVENT_TIME, MESSAGE, JSON_PARAMS, SOURCE_TXN_ID, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{positionId}, #{stockGroup}, #{stockCode}, #{eventType}, NVL(#{eventLevel}, 'INFO'), NVL(#{eventTime}, SYSDATE), #{message}, #{jsonParams}, #{sourceTxnId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, POSITION_ID, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_CODE, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_LEVEL, EVENT_TIME, MESSAGE, JSON_PARAMS, SOURCE_TXN_ID, CREATE_DATE FROM TB_S_POSITION_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND POSITION_ID = #{positionId} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} ORDER BY EVENT_TIME DESC
